title: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration - official overview

content.publisher: United Nations Commission on International Trade Law
content.citation: UNCITRAL Model Law on International Commercial Arbitration (1985), with amendments as adopted in 2006
content.reviewScope: Official HTML overview reviewed for reform objective, arbitral-process coverage and identified 2006 amendments. Enactment-status HTML reviewed for India 1996 and the based-on-or-influenced-by qualification.
content.limitations: No full article-by-article Model Law, domestic amendment/commencement or judgment verification performed. The live adoption-status table is not proof that a national enactment reproduces every Model Law article.
